findings.summary: The Q53 recursive CTE has a garbled string-concatenation line, so the query reads as broken SQL.
findings.evidence: The line renders as "UNION ALL SELECT e.id, p.pathll' > 'lle.name". The intended text is "p.path || ' > ' || e.name", and the "||" operators show as "ll".
findings.fix: Fix the glyph or escaping of "||" in this code block, for example by rendering it in the code font as on page 7 Q16, which shows it correctly. Check that the source text contains the pipes and not "ll", then re-render.

findings.summary: COUNT(col) and its NULL-skipping behaviour are shown on the data page, many pages before aggregates are taught.
findings.evidence: "SELECT COUNT(*) AS emps, COUNT(manager_id) AS mgrs, COUNT(dept_id) AS depts FROM employees;" with note "NULLs are skipped by COUNT(col)"
findings.fix: Replace this snippet with a plain query that shows the NULLs, such as SELECT * FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL OR dept_id IS NULL. Leave COUNT(col) for Q20.

findings.summary: The pushpin icons sit on top of code text in several solution blocks and hide characters.
findings.evidence: Q4: the pin covers "name" in "ORDER BY salary DESC, name;". Q1: the pin covers the ";" after "FROM departments". Q5: the pin sits under "LIMIT 3;".
findings.fix: Anchor the pin to the note's top-right corner, or add top padding or margin so it clears the last code line, instead of centring it on the note's top edge.

findings.summary: The Basics page makes a claim about WHERE, which is not taught until the next page, and gives no example for it.
findings.evidence: "`annual_pay` works in ORDER BY, but WHERE cannot see it."
findings.fix: Move this tip to the Filtering page, or reword it to say an alias can be used in ORDER BY, and drop the WHERE claim until WHERE has been introduced.

findings.summary: Question-range notation in the page titles is inconsistent, with some ranges repeating the Q prefix and others dropping it.
findings.evidence: "Basics (Q1-Q6)", "Expressions (Q14-Q19)" and "Subqueries (Q34-39)" use "Q1-Q6" and "Q14-Q19", but "Filtering (Q7-12)", "Aggregates (Q20-25)", "JOIN Queries (Q27-32)" and "Window Functions (Q41-47)" use "Q7-12" and "Q20-25".
findings.fix: Use one format across all titles, e.g. "Q7-Q12", "Q20-Q25", "Q27-Q32", "Q34-Q39", "Q41-Q47", "Q48-Q52" and "Q54-Q60".

findings.summary: Pushpin icons overlap code tokens in Q14, Q15, Q16 and Q18.
findings.evidence: Q14: the pin is over "IN" in "WHERE id IN(1,4,6);". Q15: over "IN" in "IN(6,7,8)". Q16: over "id" in "WHERE id <= 3;". Q18: over "id" in "WHERE id <= 3;".
findings.fix: Reserve vertical space between the last code line and the sticky note, or offset the pin away from the code text.

findings.summary: Q42 and Q47 use OFFSET and the WINDOW clause with no introduction. OFFSET is only explained at Q55 in the interview section.
findings.evidence: Q42: "WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY salary DESC) ORDER BY r, id OFFSET 1 LIMIT 3;" Q47: "ORDER BY salary DESC, id OFFSET 5;"
findings.fix: Add a short note on the first use of OFFSET (skips N rows) and of the named WINDOW clause. Otherwise use LIMIT or a WHERE filter in these drills and keep OFFSET for Q55.
